title: Discovery of novel BRD4-BD2 inhibitors via in silico approaches: QSAR techniques, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Tong, Jian-Bo; Xiao, Xue-Chun; Luo, Ding; Xu, Hai-Yin; Xing, Yi-Chuang; Gao, Peng; Liu, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过QSAR、分子对接和MD模拟发现BRD4-BD2抑制剂，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bromodomain-containing protein 4(BRD4) plays an important role in the occurrence and development of various malignant tumors, which has attracted the attention of scientific research institutions and pharmaceutical companies. The structural modification of most currently available BRD4 inhibitors is relatively simple, but the drug effectiveness is limited. Research has found that the inhibition of BD1 may promote the differentiation of oligodendrocyte progenitor cell; however, the inhibition of BD2 will not cause this outcome. Therefore, newly potential drugs which target BRD4-BD2 need further research. Herein, we initially built QSAR models out of 49 compounds using HQSAR, CoMFA, CoMSIA, and Topomer CoMFA technology. All of the models have shown suitable reliabilities (q(2) = 0.778, 0.533, 0.640, 0.702, respectively) and predictive abilities (r(2)(pred) = 0.716, 0.6289, 0.6153, 0.7968, respectively) for BRD4-BD2 inhibitors. On the basis of QSAR results and the search of the R-group in the topomer search module, we designed 20 new compounds with high activity that showed appropriate docking score and suitable ADMET. Docking studies and MD simulation were carried out to reveal the amino acid residues (Asn351, Cys347, Tyr350, Pro293, and Asp299) at the active site of BRD4-BD2. Free energy calculations and free energy landscapes verified the stable binding results and indicated stable conformations of the complexes. These theoretical studies provide guidance and theoretical basis for designing and developing novel BRD4-BD2 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）在多种恶性肿瘤的发生和发展中扮演重要角色，这引起了科研机构和制药公司的关注。目前大多数BRD4抑制剂的结构修饰相对简单，但药效有限。研究发现，抑制BD1可能促进少突胶质前体细胞的分化；然而，抑制BD2不会导致这一结果。因此，针对BRD4-BD2的新型潜在药物需要进一步研究。在此，我们最初使用HQSAR、CoMFA、CoMSIA和Topomer CoMFA技术，基于49种化合物构建了QSAR模型。所有模型对BRD4-BD2抑制剂均显示出适当的可靠性（q(2) = 0.778, 0.533, 0.640, 0.702）和预测能力（r(2)(pred) = 0.716, 0.6289, 0.6153, 0.7968）。基于QSAR结果及在topomer搜索模块中对R基团的搜索，我们设计了20种高活性的新化合物，这些化合物显示出合适的对接得分和适宜的ADMET特性。通过对接研究和分子动力学（MD）模拟，揭示了BRD4-BD2活性位点的氨基酸残基（Asn351、Cys347、Tyr350、Pro293和Asp299）。自由能计算和自由能景观验证了稳定的结合结果，并表明复合物具有稳定的构象。这些理论研究为设计和开发新型BRD4-BD2抑制剂提供了指导和理论基础。
